transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get our pre-load coordination huddle started. We have three loads ready for movement to the support site during the 0700-1300 window: a clinic cold-chain pallet, a generator replacement pallet, and a routine administrative-supplies pallet. We have Trucks T-1, T-2, and T-3 available, and each load needs to be assigned to one vehicle. Before I approve any assignments or loading sequence, I need transportation, maintenance control, and medical logistics to report any current handling or receiving requirements. Who wants to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, during this morning's vehicle check I confirmed that only Truck T-2 has a functioning refrigerated-power inverter approved for the clinic cold-chain pallet. That equipment note hasn't been added to the movement worksheet yet, but the cold-chain pallet needs to go on T-2.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, from maintenance control: during the current axle inspection I confirmed that Truck T-3 is limited to 2,500 kilograms, and the generator replacement pallet weighs 3,200 kilograms. That revised limitation is still awaiting entry in the vehicle status board, so it's not reflected anywhere yet. Bottom line: the generator pallet cannot be loaded on T-3.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, from medical logistics: I confirmed with the receiving clinic that there are fixed appointment times for each load — 0900 for the cold-chain pallet, 1030 for the generator replacement pallet, and 1200 for the administrative-supplies pallet. The appointment sheet hasn't been cross-referenced with the movement plan yet, so these receiving times need to be factored into our vehicle assignments and loading sequence.
